questions.question: When a woman who had bled for twelve years touched Jesus' cloak, what happened to her bleeding?

answers.text: It slowed over a few days
It stopped once she got home

questions.question: After the woman with the bleeding touched His cloak, what did Jesus say had healed her?
When messengers told synagogue leader Jairus that his daughter had died, what did Jesus tell him?

answers.text: Not to be afraid but just believe
To go home and wait for Him
To call his family together to pray

questions.question: Jesus told the daughter of a synagogue leader named Jairus to get up. She immediately got up and walked around. True or false?
